title: Top-open unit compatibility of the explicit section comparison
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ and $h:X\prime\to X$ be scheme morphisms and $F$ an etale sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Use $Z\prime$, $i\prime$, $G,H$, lift, compare, and the unit-compatibility condition of [def-weil-pbc-gabber-h0-zariski-constructions]. For every unit-compatible $\beta:i\prime_{Zar}^*G\to H$ and every $s\in G(X\prime)$, compare applied to $\beta$ of the topological unit of $s$ equals the unit-compatible etale composite pullback of lift($s$) for $h$ followed by $i\prime$, transported along pullback.condition.symm to the presentation using $\mathrm{pr}_1$ followed by $i$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image, lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. No closed immersion, representative, target section or cover is needed.

proof.text: Apply function extensionality to beta unit compatibility at the top open, obtaining equality of beta.hom.app top composed with the Zariski unit and the canonical transported étale unit. Compose this equality with gabberZariskiCompare.

Compose that function equality with the canonical étale section-unit equation and evaluate on s. Keeping the equalities at function level avoids expensive expansion of the adjunction unit during conversion.

theorem gabber_h0_zariski_top_unit_equation
    {X Z X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (h : X' ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (beta : (gabberZariskiPull (pullback.snd i h)).obj (gabberZariskiG h F) ⟶
      gabberZariskiH i h F)
    (hbeta : GabberZariskiUnitCompatible i h F beta) :
    ∀ s : (gabberZariskiG h F).obj.obj (op (⊤ : X'.Opens)),
    (gabberZariskiCompare i h F ∘ beta.hom.app (op (⊤ : (pullback i h).Opens)))
      (gabberZariskiUnit (pullback.snd i h) (gabberZariskiG h F) ⊤ s) =
    eqToHom (congrArg
      (fun k : pullback i h ⟶ X ↦ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F).obj.obj
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).obj
          (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (pullback.condition (f := i) (g := h)).symm)
      (etaleSetDescentComparison h (pullback.snd i h) F
        (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) (gabberZariskiLift h F s))
